subject: Post-discovery: schedule demo + evaluation charter setup for NovaHealth

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule demo + evaluation charter setup for NovaHealth

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal: schedule a 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff where we align success criteria, confirm scope for a 3-week trial, and walk through a demo + technical deep dive for your engineering and procurement stakeholders.
- Who we expect: your product/ML lead + CTO (you mentioned Michael) + procurement; Redwood attendees: myself + Kim.

Proposed slots (ET) — please pick one or suggest an alternative:
1) Wed Dec 9, 2026 — 10:00–11:15 ET
2) Thu Dec 10, 2026 — 14:00–15:15 ET

Proposed kickoff agenda (short):
- 10m: introductions and success criteria (customer sets priorities)
- 25m: demo focused on inference latency/cost controls and model routing
- 20m: technical deep dive: infra, VPC/SSO/keys, data handling
- 15m: trial plan, sample prompt set, deliverables, and next steps

Pre-work that would help make the session productive:
- A short list of 8–12 representative prompts or use cases you want the model to prioritize (can be redacted).
- Any must-have success metrics (latency percentile targets, throughput, quality thresholds).
- Procurement point of contact for contracting and SOC2 review.

I attached a one-page trial-charter template to speed alignment — feel free to edit and return.

[Attachment: trial-charter-template.docx]

If you confirm a time, I will send a calendar invite with a short set of pre-read links and a proposed trial plan.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.inference.com
